epics.title: Phase 0: Foundations
epics.description: Site, gates, tracker, upstream pin, fixture corpus, golden generator, Cargo workspace and CI. Everything later phases depend on to be reproducible.

epics.title: Phase 1: Core model and file format (excali-core)
epics.description: Element types, serde with unknown-field preservation, restore/migration rules, AppState, fractional indexing, library formats, payload codecs, conformance corpus.

epics.title: Phase 2: Geometry and sketch renderer
epics.description: excali-math, excali-rough (rough.js 4.6.4 semantics), excali-freehand, the display list, and golden tests against upstream output.

epics.title: Phase 3: Text and fonts (excali-text)
epics.description: Font metadata, measurement from font files, wrapping port, bound-text sizing, lazy font assets with verified licences.

epics.title: Phase 4: Headless rendering and export
epics.description: tiny-skia raster backend, SVG writer, PNG/SVG payload embedding, CLI.

epics.title: Phase 5: Web runtime and editor
epics.description: Canvas2D backend, interaction state machine, history, DOM chrome without a framework, keyboard shortcuts, the <excali-editor> custom element.

epics.title: Phase 6: Host integration (term.hut and Tauri)
epics.description: Vendored module in term.hut with CRUD and library import; tauri-plugin-excali with dialogs, headless export and allow-listed fetch; example app.

epics.title: Phase 7: Parity and polish
epics.description: Tablet and phone layouts, remaining tools, accessibility, performance budgets, locale loader, parity checklist to 100%.

epics.title: Phase 8: Release
epics.description: First calendar release v26.9.1 (ADR-009): ES module + WASM tarball as a GitHub release asset, integration guide walked by an agent in a fresh clone, tag and gh release. crates.io publishing (ex-801) is deferred by the owner.

tasks.acceptance: ADR-009 records calendar versioning YY.M.BUILD and the workspace version is 26.9.1, enforced by scripts/gates/version.py in CI; agent-workflow Human checkpoints say agents close milestones on green CI with evidence and merge term.hut PRs after green; ADR-004 has the fallback rule for unconfirmed font licences; ex-801 deferred, ex-803 walked by an agent, ex-804 tags v26.9.1 blocked by ex-802 and ex-803; the phases page Phase 8 matches; scripts/upstream/checkout.sh disables pushes to upstream and AGENTS.md and agent-workflow.md state that this is strictly a port. tasks.description: Owner decisions of 2026-09-27, binding: (a) calendar versioning YY.M.BUILD, first release 26.9.1 (tag v26.9.1); agents may tag and create GitHub releases with the ES module + WASM tarball; no crates.io, npm or other registry (ex-801 held). (b) Agents close milestones once the acceptance check passes in CI with evidence posted. (c) term.hut PRs are merged by agents after green CI. (d) Fonts: vendor only families with a confirmed OFL/MIT/Apache licence; map unconfirmed families to a licensed fallback, record the gap in ADR-004, continue. (e) ex-803 is satisfied by an agent walking the integration guide in a fresh clone in a temp dir and recording the transcript; 26.9.1 does not wait on crates.io. (f) Strictly a port: never commit, push, open PRs/issues/discussions or comment on upstream Excalidraw or any excalidraw org repo; the upstream checkout is read-only.

tasks.title: Publish crates to crates.io under excali-*
tasks.acceptance: Held: while this issue is deferred (bd status deferred, set by scripts/tasks/seed.py) it is never claimed and nothing is published. Only after the owner lifts the hold and it is returned with bd undefer: cargo publish succeeds for each crate in dependency order; versions aligned.
tasks.description: Deferred by the owner (decision of 2026-09-27): do not publish to crates.io, npm or any other registry until the owner lifts the hold. The first release (v26.9.1) ships as a GitHub release only and does not wait on this task; the crates keep publish = false and scripts/gates/version.py enforces it.

tasks.title: Integration guide walked by an agent in a fresh clone
tasks.acceptance: In a fresh clone in a temp directory (mktemp -d), an agent follows the integration guide step by step exactly as written (no steps from memory), and records the full transcript (commands and output) linked from the issue; every divergence between guide and reality is fixed in the guide and the walk repeated until clean.
evidence: Owner decision (e), 2026-09-27: satisfied by an agent walking the guide in a fresh clone in a temp dir and recording the transcript

tasks.title: Tag v26.9.1 and publish the GitHub release
tasks.acceptance: scripts/gates/version.py tag prints v26.9.1 on main; the annotated tag v26.9.1 is pushed; gh release create v26.9.1 publishes the ES module + WASM tarball and its sha256 with release notes; the site status is updated. Nothing is published to crates.io, npm or any other registry.
evidence: Owner decision (a), 2026-09-27: agents may create git tags and GitHub releases
